versions.name: Camp Shuler
versions.summary: A primitive Longhorn Council camping facility on Lake Whitney near Clifton, Texas, used for weekend unit campouts and outdoor programs.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified as a Longhorn Council property. The current Longhorn Council camp-properties and maps pages do not feature Camp Shuler, but the Waco Tribune-Herald (2025 update) names Camp Shuler at Lake Whitney as one of the closest current Boy Scout camps to Waco, so it is recorded as active. Coordinates from scout-camp-map, approximate; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: council confirmed; active status corroborated by a 2025 news source rather than the council site (which does not list it). camp_type/program_types classified conservatively as a primitive weekend-camping property; features unsurveyed.
